title: Bigger engines, closer brakes
subtitle: Fable 5.2 ships with a twin, OpenAI builds a 35-second stop, and Japan’s leak flood keeps rising
editor_note: The strongest models arrived with their brakes attached. Where nobody built one, the leaks kept coming.
